# Codes the compiler a build runs can report (TestCoverage finds them) that have no mutation
# operator yet (DECISIONS 200). This list only shrinks: TestCoverage fails on a reachable code
# that is neither here nor in the catalogue, and on a line whose code got an operator or is no
# longer reachable. One line per code: CODE reason.
E1003 the harness opens a project; E1003 is the search for project.canon failing (CLI.md §2.1), which Run never does
E1013 the harness places every root outside the project through Options.Roots, and a root inside it is always present (SPEC §3.1); internal/project's E1013_*.txtar produce it
E1014 reported for project.local.canon (GRAMMAR.md §7.2), which no generated program holds; internal/project's E1014_*.txtar produce it
E3705 an asset under an optional root absent on this machine (DECISIONS 332): the harness places every root through Options.Roots and lists none optional; internal/verify's E3705_1.txtar produces it
E7009 a load under an optional root absent on this machine (DECISIONS 332): the harness lists no root optional; internal/load's E7009_*.txtar and internal/build's E7009_1.txtar produce it
E8019 each E8019 construct is a generator gap; an operator would break once the generator implements it
E8022 a fact of the machine: two roots placed relative to each other otherwise than project.canon does (CODEGEN.md §2.8), which no generated program carries; internal/build's E8022_*.txtar produce it
E8023 build --check with an output under an absent optional root (CODEGEN.md §2.4), a fact of the machine; internal/build's E8023_*.txtar produce it
E8026 a load reading a file an emit of the same build writes (CODEGEN.md §2.4, DECISIONS 341), which a generated program's loads never name; internal/build's E8026_*.txtar produce it
E8027 a symbolic link below an output's root (CODEGEN.md §2.4, DECISIONS 342), a fact of the machine; internal/build's E8027_*.txtar produce it
E8028 build --only-root only (DECISIONS 343), which the harness never runs: it builds with no OnlyRoot; internal/build's E8028_*.txtar and internal/cli's build_only_root_lock.txtar produce it
W6006 reported by canon lock check only (LOCK.md §8), which neither check nor build runs
W8024 an output under an absent optional root (CODEGEN.md §2.4), a fact of the machine; internal/build's W8024_*.txtar produce it
